title: Uruguayan Chivito Empanadas
description: A twist on traditional empanadas, filling them with Uruguayan-style chivito meat and serving them with a Mexican flair.
instructions: 2. Roll out the empanada dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
3. Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
4. In a pan, heat the Laudable Olive Oil over medium heat.
5. Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
6. Add the diced red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
7. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
8. Stir in the Chivito Sauce and cook for 1 minute.
9. Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto one half of each dough circle.
10. Sprinkle shredded cheese over the beef mixture.
11. Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
12. Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with Laudable Olive Oil.
13. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
